name: Dayton
takeaway: Dayton's SOPEC rate explodes from 8.71¢ to 10.691¢ in June 2026 — a 22.7% increase. This is the single strongest pain play in Ohio right now. Any commercial account in Dayton should be contacted this week.
hook: Dayton's SOPEC program is jumping from 8.71 to over 10.6 cents in June — that's nearly a quarter more on the electric bill. Have you talked to your customers about locking in something before it hits?
notes: SOPEC (Sustainable Ohio Public Energy Council) contract: 8.71¢/kWh through June 2026, repricing to 10.691¢/kWh. AES Ohio (formerly Dayton Power & Light) territory. Highest near-term rate pain in the state.
